title: Small Voxel City Demo
author: Roenbaeck
selftext:
This is a tech demo of a small city consisting of 32 million voxels. It's runnable on macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows (Nvidia, AMD, Intel)) and on Linux.  
  
[https://github.com/Roenbaeck/voxelot/releases/tag/v0.2.0](https://github.com/Roenbaeck/voxelot/releases/tag/v0.2.0)  


The engine is made entirely by AI, but through human design and guidance.

replies.author: Roenbaeck
replies.body: Perlin noise for the ground height variation, then a random selection of ”biomes” taking up square regions on the map. There are already more biomes in the code than shown in this map. The map generation is currently a separate program in the same repository.

replies.author: Roenbaeck
replies.body: Yes, there are greedy meshers running simultaneously in different threads. Individual voxels are rendered close to the camera until meshes become available. Further away bounding boxes of the chunks are rendered as a fallback.
